validation_repairs: First full run: 328/330 web tests passed. Corrected two fixture assumptions: root replacement preserves existing ASSET_CHANGED code; native timeline wrapper content hashes change during Undo/Redo, so file media are compared separately.

A static concurrent retry review found already-applied jobs could report canceled; stopped the second bounded build, fixed ready/applied replay and terminal receipt lookup, and added a deterministic success/failure owner regression before repeating full validation.

After interrupting compilation, the linker reported undefined hidden symbols in vv-web intermediates. Cleaned only that package under the same resource limits, retaining the cached toolchain and all dependencies; full validation then passed.

Finite API fixture expectations were corrected for existing ASSET_NOT_READY cancellation responses and the existing server_restarted:true receipt marker. No production change was needed for either expectation.

Review of large batch reports found the original 4096-byte receipt entry cap too small. Entries now allow 1 MiB within the unchanged 8 MiB journal; native preparation and large import acknowledgments retire cached receipts by bytes as well as count, with a deterministic memory-budget regression.
